subject: Evolved Gut Bacteria Extend Lifespan in Flies: Acetate as the Molecular Bridge
script: From Agewell Brief: Evolved Gut Bacteria Extend Lifespan in Flies: Acetate as the Molecular Bridge. A preprint shows that directed evolution of Lactiplantibacillus plantarum to resist oxidative stress boosts acetate production, which alone extends Drosophila lifespan and reduces gut aging. Aging is written in the gut. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
